# Area: videoframes

Started by the build lead from this brief (2026-11-13). It is the definition of done.

Josh (Nov 13): cut every fal Veo clip into frames and get them into the game as stand-in flipbooks (not passes). Clips (read-only, copy them into this lane; the paths are under ../<lane>/pipeline/art/proof/ in the sibling worktrees): artella2/video/ella-down.mp4, ella-hurt.mp4, ella-transition.mp4; artfx/GoldImpact/Video/gold-impact.mp4; artfx2/ClockBeat/video/clip.mp4; artshots/bolt-hit/Video/bolt-hit.mp4 (use bolt-hit-trim.mp4 if it is the cut one), artshots/owl-bolt/Video/owl-bolt.mp4, artshots/wand-shot/Video/wand-shot.mp4; enemy/{ArmillaryF,RepeaterF,SundialF}/video/{*-attack,*-hurt,*-turn}.mp4 (in artenemy/artenemy2 worktrees). Skip artvideo/ella-idle.mp4 (the stand-ins lane imports it) and artella/preview/*_preview.mp4 (previews, not clips). Merge origin/main first.
For each clip: python3 tools/build/video_to_strip.py at 24 frames (the same keying, registration and crop the idle used; --grid-cols for a grid sheet when a strip passes 8192 px), with its .sprite.json; copy into pipeline/art/proof/videoframes/<piece>/ with a provenance row (origin: generated in jam, fal Veo 3.1 Fast clip cut into frames, stand-in, not passed). Map each to its slot (python3 tools/build/art_slots.py list; e.g. ella-state:Hurt/Down/Transition, the enemy family's attack/hurt/turn, shot:wand/owl-bolt/bolt-hit, vfx gold impact, clock beat) and import it as a flipbook into the slot's existing _PH texture with tools/build/assets/import_art_candidate.py, the way the Ella idle grid is imported. Never write a pass record; never touch references.json, approvals.json or another lane's worktree. A clip with no drawing slot: still cut it, record it in docs/build/areas/videoframes-status.md, skip the import.
Batches: Ella (3), shots and effects (5), enemies (9). After each batch: build, one capture (run_game.sh -SmokeShotFrames=600) that shows at least one of them, PRECHECK_FAST=1 bash tools/build/lane_precheck.sh videoframes --bg until PASS, commit, so the gate lands each batch. End with the count imported per batch and the clips skipped and why.
